$comment: Deterministic drafting standard for Korean residential floor plans (user khs0927). Every agent must read this file before drawing or fixing a plan and must not override a value here without the user's approval. Source of truth for values: the user's own left sheet in Drawing2 (verified 2026-09-29) and explicit user instructions.

reference_drawing.rule: When a style is not covered here, cad_query the left sheet and copy it exactly (geometry AND layer). Never invent.

CON.role: exterior concrete wall outline (closed polyline per wall segment between openings)

WAL1.role: interior MASONRY (조적) wall; green; hatch ANSI31

LIGHT_WALL.role: interior LIGHT partition (경량벽체); white; no hatch
LIGHT_WALL.layer_name: UNCONFIRMED - ask user for the layer name

WINBAR.role: window jambs, sash stiles, meeting stiles

WINELE.role: window frame faces, sash frame lines, window centre mark

walls.segmenting: one CLOSED polyline per wall run between openings; openings always break the wall
walls.junctions: corners and T-junctions of the SAME material are one polygon (L/U/T shape); no seam line across the wall thickness and no empty square at the corner
walls.material_boundary: keep the joint line where CON meets WAL1 (different materials)
walls.classification: masonry vs light is a DESIGN decision: ask the user per wall when not given. Never guess.

centre_lines.outer_end: runs out to the first dimension guide line (plan edge + 1500)
centre_lines.must_not_cross: rooms that the wall does not bound (e.g. a lower-room wall line must stop 400 past the corridor-side face, not run through the upper bathroom/kitchen)

measured_in_house_plan.user_instruction: top room row sits on the upper guide line, next to the overall row (2026-09-29)

dimensions.rule: every row has its own guide line; a row whose centre lines were removed is deleted, not left floating

sliding_window.name: 미서기창 (2 sashes)
sliding_window.orientation: y=0 is the EXTERIOR face; for a wall whose exterior is +Y, mirror y -> 200 - y

parts.rule: left jamb mirrored x -> W - x

variables.W: opening width (wall end to wall end)

sheet.scale_formula: block_scale = 0.5 * (denominator / 100) for A3; e.g. A3 1/80 -> 0.4, A3 1/100 -> 0.5
scale_texts: 'SCALE _ A1 1 / N/2 , A3 1 / N' under drawing title
sheet.rule: sheet scale must equal the dimension style scale (DIMSCALE)

procedure: cad_query the reference sheet for any style you are about to draw
build all edits as one cad_batch with expect_fingerprint on every target
cad_snapshot the result next to the reference sheet and compare visually
ask the user to save (the plugin never saves)
open_questions: Which interior walls are masonry and which are light partitions (per wall).
